dialect_sources.source: Biene... it's clear something has been weighing heavily on you. You've visited me more and more as of late.
dialect_sources.target: 姑娘……你显然有很重的心事。最近你来看我的次数越来越多了。

dialect_sources.source: Though I must ask, Biene, why you do not go to your husband in times like these?
dialect_sources.target: 不过我得问问，姑娘，这种时候你为什么不去找你的丈夫？

dialect_sources.source: Aye, my lady. I believe the Lord sends us visions through dreams, to inspire us to follow His word in our waking hours.
dialect_sources.target: 相信，王后。我相信主通过梦赐予我们异象，引导我们在清醒时遵循他的话语。

dialect_sources.source: It all happened so quickly, Biene. The death, the funeral, and the wedding. It was over so soon.
dialect_sources.target: 一切都发生得太快了，姑娘。他的死、葬礼，还有婚礼。那么快就都结束了。

dialect_sources.source: Of course, Biene. After all, you have a kingdom to run.
dialect_sources.target: 当然，姑娘。毕竟，你还有一个王国要治理。

dialect_sources.source: You may not recognize my wisdom or respect my age, but Ophelia is a smart lass. She knows better.
dialect_sources.target: 你也许不认可我的智慧，也不敬重我的年纪，但奥菲莉娅是个聪明姑娘。她比你懂得多。

dialect_sources.source: Hrmph. If yer lord finds you so useful, why does he ask you to guard the bedchambers and empty walls?
dialect_sources.target: 哼。要是你家大人觉得你这么有用，为什么让你守着寝室和空无一人的城墙？

dialect_sources.source: Aye. She is not here of her own accord.
dialect_sources.target: 知道。她不是自愿来这里的。

dialect_sources.source: Ay, Maike... What's got your father all in a rush so?
dialect_sources.target: 哎，姑娘……你父亲怎么急成这样？
